Kyrre Johnson appears a haggard middle aged man, his face marked from many years in biting cold climates. He is clad in large tattered furs even though the temperature is not nearly low enough for such apparel. 

Growing up in northern England to parents emigrating from the frozen arctic lands, Kyrre grew up on stories of a sky where the sun would never set - or never rise, and lights dancing in the sky.

After beginning his studies, and successively being approached by the Golden Dawn, his mind naturally went to the north when hearing the profecy. Soon after his body would follow. Convinced that the answer to the first half of the profecy must pertain to the seemingly magical essence of the lights of the North, he spent 10 years theorising and experimenting, and going on expeditions.

It was one of these expeditions where he stumbled upon a magical force, scarring his body with icy blue markings, and granting him affinity with cold.

Now a new opportunity arises - magical western lands call. Maybe travelling here might grant insight into the other half of the profecy? The Golden Dawn sure seemed to want him to go.

Fettachini was sent to divine med school by his parents to become a cleric, but his true passion was always cooking. He skipped out on the majority of his classes to sneak away and train under the cafeteria chef. A prodigy in noodle crafting, the flying spaghetti claimed Fettachini, his visage forming in his most masterfully made pot of pasta. Fettachini continued his service to FSM, until one tragic day where an uncontrolled burst of pasta power started a divine grease fire in the cafeteria, its hungry garlic infused flames ravaging the university. Fettachini was cast out in shame, his parents disowned him, banished him from their lands, and the university expelled him. Now, Fettachini is on a holy quest to control his power, heal the wounded with his divine noodleness, and prove to himself and his parents that he is worthy of respect. For all his good intentions, skipping classes didn't exactly make him the most... respectable... of clerics.

Fettachini always carries an extremely stale breadstick strapped to his back like a staff, a heavy straining spoon on his belt as if it were a mace, and wears a colander on his head in observance of his Lord and Savior, FSM. He is 19 and 5'8.

Goose was a goose, happy to be horrible and terrible. One day some *honker* decided to turn them into a bird person because of my terrible terrible crimes against humanity; I mean the door to the bakery was just open, I mean come on! I need to find someone to turn me back into my former glory as a full goose. Also making money on the side is cool too...
also if you point out my human limb I will get VERY offended

Traxim grew up in London, admiring the many artisans who turned basic materials into works of art. It was this that lead to him taking his first apprenticeship (and several more after that). After he had learned a broad base of crafting skills, he felt comfortable picking a name and striking out on his own. He found a home in the Southwark Artisans’ League. It was at the guild hall that he learned of the Freemasons which led to him joining 4 years ago. Recently, his guild leaders announced that they would be sponsoring a voyage to the New World and Traxim knew he must go. He is hoping to find a patron that shares his vision of making a great city on the wilds of the New World.
 Traxim is fairly tall and svelte with blue skin and purple eyes. He can often be found talking to whoever will listen (even if it’s just him) about his latest project.

Storm is a blue dragonborn paladin, but he wasn’t always. He used to be a pirate, first mate in fact, but something happened to his crew and ship, he won’t say what. Some say he went crazy and killed them all and sunk the ship. Others say another pirate came along and destroyed them. But whatever happened, he was supposed to die with them, but he was saved by the sea and nature goddess Melora, giving him new hope and drive.
   He began training as a paladin and fighting for what is right, and for goodness in this world, this sentiment only growing after the darkest day when Melora was corrupted and slain.

Cato (pronounced Kay-Toe) is part of the Combat Field Scholars guild. He was set at the foot steps of the guild when he was just a baby, no parents to be found. He does not feel any resentment regarding his orphan status the guild is his family. They raised him teaching him how to fight, survive, and most importantly, think. He worked with them becoming a field scout. His Tabaxi race made him very mobile bringing back useful information that others would not have been able to acquire.
He is sure of himself although not arrogant believing that he should always stay centered as emotional thinking creates poor decisions. He is coming to Roanoke to provide wisdom and guidance as the island brings many unknown issues. You can expect comfort in knowing that he is always watching your blind spot and will provide you with truthful information.

Charismatic and quick, Skitter has adapted well to the life in the Streets of London. Skit is known to entertain onlookers while friends relieve the wealthier of some of their extra coin. Known to hide in small and dark spaces, Skitter has learned to evade capture and stay safe. 
5' 3"
Small, freckled, covered in grime. 
Rodent like features.
Never seen without a small grey mouse.

Hello I am Pearl Windfall a lingering soul. I am a young Pallid Elf who's Aristocratic life lead who down a selfish path and to her relatively young death.  She is still very child like young by Elf standards never actually an adult but she has "lived" a long life/ afterlife and seen many things. Her biggest wish is to not be alone anymore and to "live" a life that is less selfish. She wheres a Silver cornet on her white/ silver hair that has small blue stones that glow in the sun and moon light. She has traveled much in her current form and does not truely feel that she is "dead" but understands that she is undead. Due to her child like nature she has she gets bored fast and like to pull tricks from time to time. Although she has realized that even as a soul she can still be harmed so she has chosen the path of a  Poltergeist as a way to defend herself. Her dream is still to have someone to call "friend" and be helpful rather than selfish. She hopes that the journey and new land will allow her to have a true clean start and perhaps find how she truly became a Lingering Soul for so long.
She has a cold dim light to her at all times 5 ft radius
cPersonality Traits

I have different assumptions from those around me concerning personal space, blithely invading others’ space in innocence, or reacting to ignorant invasion of my own. I begin or end my day with small traditional rituals that are unfamiliar to those around me.

Ideals

Adventure. I’m far from home, and everything is strange and wonderful! (Chaotic)

Bonds

My freedom is my most precious possession. I’ll never let anyone take it from me again.

Flaws

I have a weakness for the exotic beauty of the people of these lands.

“HA! Oh, you got away you tricky bugger. You there - come on over, sit a spell. Pick up a pole and bait it if you like, or grab a bottle and have a sip or three. I tell ya - I’ve fished all over hell and half the Empire, and I’ve never seen ‘em bitin’ livelier than today! I’ve been a fisherman for most of my 65 years, since I was old enough to wrestle ‘em inta the boat. I’ve working saltwater and fresh, been everywhere a fish takes bait, and traveled where the work took me. I died in a bar fight once (s’alright but a bit cold) but the Goddesses and Gods brought me back on account of how good I was at Relaxin’. Even made me a wee God, got a portfolio and everything. Oh, sorry, I forgot to introduce m’self - Thomas Creek, the Wee God of Relaxin’! HA! Nah, it’s not the wine - tell yah what, are ye done workin’ for the day? Hard work, was it? Ah, splendid! Well then, settle yerself on the ground, and I’ll tell ye all about it. Others’ll be here soon, and then the Relaxin’ can begin in earnest!” Thomas Creek, Water Genasi Monk/Sorcerer, the Wee God of Relaxin’, which is a quite specific form of revelry that can only be properly practised and appreciated by those who labor.

Navar oaken, C/G Barbarian firbolg age 442, lazaurian oath background research type. He's a rugged and simple man carrying a broken heart from the loss of chauntea and the damage her absence caused to the lands of nature. He is bent on finding answers and peace in the new world, something to give him hope that the lands can be restored. He's a faithful servant and generous heart but he has nightmares of blights arising in the woods and monsters ravaging the soil and those who work it. He keeps away from people when he sleeps but on more than one occasion they would be able to hear bitter screams of terror

Visual until I get a picture: thick but short facial hair on a broad 6'11 firbolg man, he wears no tunic or shirt but does have a vest with straps and pockets for his tools weapons and the like with a handbag over his shoulder for the rest of his things. The bag is decorated with dragon scales of each of the metallic colors and his chest has a branding of the holy symbol of chauntea (self inflicted)

Addition for the server:
"I've lived my entire live struggling. Taming wild lands, staving off raiders, poachers, and 'civilized' folk. It gets more than I can bare at times without chauntea. But I swear even if I must perish, or fight a thousand monsters and demons, I will find some path to bring her back. No price is too heavy"

**```yaml
Royaume

Built for the lavish, built for the famous, built for the few - the model TZ-103, Royaume. One of the very first autonomous machines, the Royaume is built to serve. And serve he does, via day-to-day activities, personal engagement, or even... Enforcement by violence. Though hopefully never needing to be used, the TZ-103 comes equipped with a fold-out blade roughly 103 cm long, fully modular for upgrades. Buy yours today!
```**

The particular mechanical person was built for a private buyer in London, a strange man who chose to free Royaume rather than accept him into his service.

Now masterless, Roy is seeking a new life in London and eventually in the New World. He's trying to find out who he is other than a servant.

A disheveled human with a past shrouded in mystery, he appears to be a human man who introduces himself as Zeke. With a slouched posture and dark brown hair hidden beneath a hood, he does not usually stand out in a crowd, however, when standing erect at 6"2 he can draw attention when necessary. Betrayed by his comrades and left to take the fall for a job gone wrong, Zeke managed to evade capture by the authorities and set out to start a new life.

Rahvioli is an Alchemist that seeks the Philosopher's stone. After hearing numerous rumors about it's location in the New World, he decided to travel there and search for it. He is six feet tall and shines a brilliant white against the light.

He is rather secretive about his past, but one thing he makes clear over everything else is he hates pasta with a passion.
Oh my god the anti Fettichini
bald eagle? full on patriotic.
cool

Ember is a noble rogue fire genasi. He has a visitor every month, though he doesn’t speak about it or his past much, if at all. He isn’t welcome in the fire, water, or air kingdoms, and extremely welcome in the earth kingdom. He refuses to explain anything about his past, except to the ones he greatly loves and cares about.

Ebuc Xibur. Vedalken Artificer.a general whiz-kid growing up in an orphanage. He always declined looking for a family and concentrated his inginuity to helping the orphanage stay intact. Years passed as a wandering repairman before joining a guild. Now on assignment as an engineer for the sub.

Calmation Psychic is Firbolg from Britain, his family have lived off their successful shop for many years either providing fortunes of both Divine and other natures to any patrons who come into the How-dini. However, Calmation himself is on a bit of a self-finding path for the time being unsure if he is fit for the business. He finds himself drawn towards the boat launch from a series of dreams and visions he assumes from his god Savras, eventually boarding curiously hoping the boat trip will better his understanding. Calmation and his family are of a redder skin/fur? Variety of Firbolg, he is 7 3 and around 300ish years old.

Faewynne Cobblepot's father died on his first adventure aboard a pirate ship. Their mother was a great hero of the land when she was in her prime, but has since retired following the death of her husband. Mentored in their youth by Storm Fawcett, they struck out at a young age, beginning their training as warlock. They worshipped the corrupted god Ilmater. They are looking to protect those who cannot protect themselves at any cost. They are a firbolg, only 17 years old. They're short for a firbolg, only reaching a height of 6'7". Their fur is a pinkish grey with dark red brown hair. They will not tolerate being called anything but Wynne.

Ife ever since he was born was met with backlash. His family going into hiding his mother ended up masquerading as a human and gaining a small fortune. Ife bitter over his mothers seemingly betrayal left home as soon as he was of age, swindling and making Petty crimes to pay rent and eat, he got cocky and decided to masquerade as a popular noble in the state, he got a lot of money as a result but within the lie he fell for one of the nobles affairs. A sweet firebolg woman. But when he eventually got caught with the noble finally having gotten out where he put him, his love saw him nothing but a disgusting fraud and he ran now even more on the run and heartbroken. He's still a flirt to this day and a menace but he plays the field better and tries to get redeem himself after that...well somewhat

Baeshra earned her name among her tribe due to her unique hunting style, crawling around on all fours and striking from the shadows. Preferring her teeth and claws over more conventional weapons. However, she was exiled from her tribe due to killing a youngling. It was not intentional, the young Subeak was mimicking her hunting style without her knowledge and she struck thinking it was a predator stalking her rather than one of her own. 

She left amicably and has lived with the silent burden of what she'd done. Moving around place to place she learned the intricacies of taste and flavors. And while she does prefer to eat her food raw, there is something unique about different flavors and cooking she wishes to learn more off.

The not so fair and wild Mungo Loco. From the old world comes a talentless bard who uses his skills of entertainment and charm to get things his way.  He is effective at persuading and deceiving others and is sometimes seen as a cheat, with rogue like tendencies however idolises people such as Robin Hood.  Mungo's new adventures into the new world are motivated by seeking wealth and opportunities to one day open his own tavern, by any means necessary
Castor Pierce

Standing tall at six foot two, and weighing in, fit at 161 lbs, Astella is the epitome of modern aristocracy. They wear fine clothes designed by skilled florentine artisans, and have a long tail that trails behind them. Their horns are adorned with lilies and irises, the symbols of their homeland, and red markings adorn their body.

Astella was born as the first child of Cosimo II de'Medici. Astella, however, was unfortunately born with female genitalia, meaning they would never hold power... or so they all vainly thought.

Astella was thirteen when their father died of tuberculosis. Fending for themself under the teachings of Galileo and other artisans, they learned much of the world. They had a hunger – a deep, seething passion – for innovation, to unlock the secrets of the universe. But they had a mind for economics, and when their father disbanded the Medici banks, they were secretly crushed. Their younger brother, Ferdinando II, started his reign at the ripe age of ten, and this was to much of Astella's dismay. 

Astella started planting seeds. They knew their brother was a weak-minded fool, and their brother was nothing compared to their father and their ancestors, Cosimo I and II. They started sewing seeds of doubt, and paranoia, and control into their brother's psyche, enough that by the time their brother was twenty-two, they had him in their pocket. 

Sadly, Astella's best friend and mentor, Galileo Galilei, was being harassed by the Roman Inquisition, and there wasn't much that they could do about it. Seeing their brother being puppetted by Rome, they knew what they had to do. They convinced Ferdinando to give them the title of Grand Duke of Florence, the equivalent of their brother's title, in an effort to "protect the family, so if anything were to happen to him, they could keep the Medici name intact". 

They ran off with twenty florins' worth of gold in a locked bag of holding, and used half of it to pay for Galileo's "disappearance" to a more peaceful land. They then booked passage on a ship to the New World, determined to be free from the bondage of gender and the papal state, all the while keeping the Medici name intact.

Are you seeing double? Nope, thats just Rigatony de Voxar, The Honorable

This 5'11 hottie is the heir to the Voxar family line. Never heard of them? Good. They Prefer it that way. It won't stop Riga from making up numerous titles as he goes. When he is not dressed in a young lord's finery, Riga walks around in sleek, grey Mithril armor, but only dons his helmet for special occasions. 

You will notice when he moves, an afterimage of him shimmers behind him. It has fangs and occasionally slips into his shadow. Sometimes it's wearing a colander, sometimes it has wings. Cheery! Right? They both wield a long white greatsword that Riga occasionally yells at.

Laura Lyrefall is the only child in the horrible family that is Lyrefall.  To deal with the stress, she goes on  hunts with the highgate hunting club. Because better to kill exotic animals than people. 

She is sent to go to the new world to start new roots of the Lyrefall family and start business there. However, Laura just wants to be free and develop her own established title before cutting ties from the family.

Sylric was an English soldier that joined when he was far too young in hopes for an adventure. He is friendly and loves making friends while playing cards and was really good at it. He left the military as they kept him inside managing supplies and nothing more. Killing time at a desk more often then being outside. Sylric heavily practiced in both his work time and free time, with the mindset that he will have to be ready for any real wars that might come, but it felt that something like that would never come. It was bitter sweet to him, he's glad that people are safe and no one was fighting each other, but it was never for the purpose of making his country proud or to even go out to war, but so he could find something interesting or something different from his homeland or even his hometown for that matter. It was not until some of his good friends both outside the military and inside that he told about a promise for a better adventure and more opportunities in the well known town and only a little ways from where he was, London.  With that in mind and a strong passion to leave the unwanted military and to find a better adventure. He left the military and excitement of change, Sylric headed for London!

After atonement, Arctura has become very different in appearance. Their hair is cut, no longer in long braids but short and wavy. Its ends are now radiant gold, which matches the gold constellations that now cover their teal-blue skin. Leaving behind their infernal roots, the inside of their wings are indigo. Their wings are like star charts, their horns, tail tip and fingertips the same shade of deep blue. The flowers on their horns have turned to wildflowers, and they smell of home. (Hair is like selfie above but a bit longer) Their eyes are gold all the way through.
(Art is coming)

"Lucky" is not but a nickname of the jackalope elder tufter. A kind soul of boundless energy and sharp words known for protecting other cryptids by aggravating huntsmen who come to terrorize them. He's highly curious of new colonists to the area and loves learning secrets and tricks from people which has led to some adept spellcasting and a mind honed for it. He sees himself as a local guide to friendly colonists but enforcer to those that oppress the land and it's rightful people.
(HF model made by <@237577351532249110> vote sandigill

"Rockman" and his sidekick "Rush" are a duo unlike any other. Built to protect the ones many see as weak, their childlike features appeal to every aspect they strive for. Constructed by the izzet engineer Ebuc Xibur. Upon Ebuc's missing signal, the set became active and on standby until being found by a small gathering on the beaches of roanoke.

Gredrich Nova, intrepid gambler, whole hardy drunk. He is drunk most of the time with his long fiery orange hair, tied in a loose, low ponytail. He is pale in complexion, freckles covering most his face with deep green eyes. Occasionally, he can be seen playing his viol on the streets for extra coin to either gamble it or buy alcohol.
